scope: Synthetic v0.8 metadata-cleaning and document-details audit; bounded corroboration, not exhaustive anonymity certification.

tools.ffprobe: ffprobe version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2007-2026 the FFmpeg developers

methods.images_pdf_rtf: Independent ExifTool before/after metadata extraction; source canary must be observed before removal is credited.
methods.office_packages: Separate Python standard-library ZIP/XML reader scans all XML text/attributes/tails; raw decompressed parts and neutral ZIP fields also checked.
methods.media: Independent full ffprobe stream/container/chapter output; MP4 H.264/AAC and audio-only FLAC confirmed.
methods.flattened_pdf: Poppler pdftotext returned no selectable text; qpdf --check succeeded.
methods.reports: Synthetic private canary absent from each cleaning sidecar.

limitations: ExifTool cannot decode Office ZIP metadata in this environment because its optional Perl Archive::Zip module is unavailable; Office cases use the separate ZIP/XML reader instead.
Fixtures are synthetic and small. No universal forensic or anonymity claim is made.
Visible personal content and documented hidden Office content remain outside the metadata-cleaning policy.
BMP metadata trailer removal is covered by application behavior/tests; this independent tagged-fixture matrix covers the image formats listed in cases.

confirmed_bugs_fixed.issue: Word protection hash/salt were retained by cleanup. Word text hidden only in web view bypassed the vanish check.
confirmed_bugs_fixed.resolution: Reject documentProtection/writeProtection and enabled webHidden before publishing.

confirmed_bugs_fixed.issue: PPTX non-whitespace element tails and malformed relationship text/children could retain private data.
confirmed_bugs_fixed.resolution: Reject hidden XML text outside slide text runs and malformed relationship bodies.

confirmed_bugs_fixed.issue: An ODF relative external formula such as of:=['../PrivateWorkbook.ods'#$Sheet1.A1] survived cleanup.
confirmed_bugs_fixed.resolution: Reject OpenFormula quoted external-document references, including relative paths; local formulas remain supported.

confirmed_bugs_fixed.issue: Metadata inspector validation failed for real HEIC because Pillow reports HEIF, which is not a FileFormat identifier.
confirmed_bugs_fixed.resolution: Map decoded image container through the existing registered FORMATS mapping.

verified: One embedded DejaVuSans font and one standard Helvetica font correctly distinguish embedding flags.
A 250 by 350 point PDF page rotated 90 degrees reports 350 by 250 display points and rotation 90.
Attachment name and 12-byte size are correct; no extraction was requested.
warnings: Poppler emitted a fontconfig cache warning; commands returned success and reported font/geometry/attachment facts.

cases.qpdf_check: Passed: no syntax or stream encoding errors found.

test_review: Retained format/parser rejection, original preservation, output rollback and independent reader cases. Added regressions target reproduced failure paths; no redundant implementation-mirroring tests were added.
